discrepancies.problem: Five or six aspecting planets in uploaded English Saravali Ch35.6 vs Sanskrit four (Moon excluded).
discrepancies.consequence: Different predicate prevalence. Freeze translated and Sanskrit alternatives as separate methods; do not retroactively revise prediction case studies.

discrepancies.problem: Retrograde in exaltation positive effect lost attributed to some versus retrograde benefics strong elsewhere in same source, with Sanskrit phala/bala variant.
discrepancies.consequence: No blanket rule of retrograde invariably strong or weak; require explicit authority/version and relational conditions.

discrepancies.problem: Sarvarth Chintamani extreme seven-exalted versus six-exalted conditions erroneously treated as equally physically impossible in an intermediate progress comment.
discrepancies.consequence: All seven impossible from Sun Aries and Mercury Virgo. Six is NOT categorically impossible because the missing seventh may be Mercury; individual six-planet feasibility requires sky calculations. Do not classify untested six as empty.

project_rules.not_trust_retrograde_unconditional_trans: Bhasin Ch9 PDF223 generalizes to 'always', but original verse4 gives conjunction of friendly and retrograde sign strength with other dignities. Keep commentator-only.
